section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 2001
title: A total of 2,71,019 accidental deaths were reported in the country during 2001, (15,136 more than such deaths reported in 2000.) accounting for an increase of 5.9 per cent as compared to previous year. Correspondingly, 2.5 per cent increase in the population and 3.4 per cent increase in the rate of Accidental Deaths were reported during this year. Table — 1 (A) Percentage change in population, incidence and rate of accidental deaths over the corresponding previous year during 1991 to 2001
